lines.say: Nobody tells you what a six-item cart turns into after midnight.
Late at night, his phone lights up. Six items. A big order.
He's sitting up now. Cooker whistles. The beach trip's all planned.
lines.show: Sits up. Cooker whistles. Goa trip planned.

lines.say: A few minutes later. Cart's down to half.
A bit later. Just a single item left. So the beach trip's a day trip now.
Then, order placed! A small order, cash on delivery.
A minute later. The order's gone.
He's staring at the ceiling till sunrise. You know the feeling.
lines.show: Stares at the ceiling. Till sunrise.
